scope: Computational artificial-life research: integer programs on a bounded virtual machine, search operators and simulated populations of software objects. No biological material, organism, procedure or design of any kind.
evolved_forensics: NOT_APPLICABLE per world without a crossing
instrument_validation: A' instruments on the P-J02 XOR-1 witnesses: cue causality, register corruption before the ask tick, control / inserted-instruction knockouts

expected_on_witness.register_corruption: 0 for every register (the word is read during the tick)
expected_on_witness.knockout of the XOR: reward falls to the identity level (~.5)

material_rule: not material (instrument validation only) unless an evolved organism exists
